title: Mechanism of Brucea javanica against multiple myeloma via TNF-NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Wang, Yuan; Zhang, Aijia; Chen, Yang; Qi, Daoda; Peng, Chengyi; Liang, Zihao; Guo, Jingjing; Gu, Yan; Li, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究鸦胆子治疗多发性骨髓瘤的TNF-NF-kappaB机制，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study aims to explore the pharmacological mechanism of Brucea javanica (BJ) in treating multiple myeloma (MM) through network pharmacology and validate this mechanism via in vitro experiments. Active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) of BJ and their potential targets were identified, along with MM-related targets. By plotting protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks, hub genes responsible for BJ in treating MM were identified and subjected to molecular docking. In MM cell lines H929 and U266, regulatory effects of BJ and luteolin (the major compound of BJ) on the behaviors of MM cells were examined. BJ extract exhibited dose-dependent cytotoxicity against MM cells, with IC(50) values of 5.03 microL/mL (48 h) for H929, and 1.06 microL/mL (48 h) for U266. Network pharmacology identified 14 APIs and 11 hub genes, with molecular docking confirming strong binding affinity between luteolin and TNF (-8.001 kcal/mol). 48-hour luteolin treatment suppressed MM cell proliferation (IC(50): 84.73 microM for H929; 46.93 microM for U266), induced apoptosis (up to 53.03% and 9.22% late apoptosis in H929 and U266 at 80 microM), and arrested cell cycle at G0/G1 phase. It downregulated TNF/NF-kappaB pathway components, reducing mRNA levels of TNF, IL-6, and NFKB1, and protein levels of p105, p50, and p65. TNF-alpha secretion decreased in luteolin-treated cells to 10.62% in H929 cells and 67.25% in U266 cells. This study demonstrates that BJ inhibits MM progression primarily via suppression of the TNF/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, with luteolin as a pivotal bioactive compound.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过网络药理学探讨鸦胆子（Brucea javanica, BJ）治疗多发性骨髓瘤（multiple myeloma, MM）的药理机制，并通过体外实验验证该机制。鉴定了BJ的活性药物成分（active pharmaceutical ingredients, APIs）及其潜在靶点，以及MM相关靶点。通过绘制蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络，确定了BJ治疗MM的关键基因（hub genes），并进行了分子对接（molecular docking）。在MM细胞系H929和U266中，检测了BJ及其主要化合物木犀草素（luteolin）对MM细胞行为的调控作用。BJ提取物对MM细胞表现出剂量依赖性细胞毒性，H929的半数抑制浓度（IC(50)）为5.03微升/毫升（48小时），U266为1.06微升/毫升（48小时）。网络药理学鉴定了14种APIs和11个关键基因，分子对接确认木犀草素与TNF之间具有强结合亲和力（-8.001千卡/摩尔）。48小时木犀草素处理抑制了MM细胞增殖（H929的IC(50)为84.73微摩尔；U266为46.93微摩尔），诱导凋亡（在80微摩尔浓度下，H929和U266的晚期凋亡率分别高达53.03%和9.22%），并将细胞周期阻滞在G0/G1期。它下调了TNF/NF-kappaB通路组分，降低了TNF、IL-6和NFKB1的mRNA水平，以及p105、p50和p65的蛋白水平。木犀草素处理细胞中TNF-α分泌减少，H929细胞降至10.62%，U266细胞降至67.25%。本研究证明，BJ主要通过抑制TNF/NF-kappaB信号通路来抑制MM进展，其中木犀草素是关键生物活性化合物。
